name: Jere Friedman
reason: Strict health rule: his Gong2Heaven page sells his breathwork and gong journeys with promises of deep healing of wounds, grief and traumas and releasing toxins from the body's cells, the yoga nidra sessions claim better sleep (one hour said to equal four hours of deep sleep), and his Spiral Light studio page carries a testimonial about sound baths helping a child with autism; his own YouTube is mostly short gong clips and event promos. Owner may reconsider: his coaching, meditation classes and Authentic Man men's circles are free of claims.
